subject.title: fix(google-meet): bound Calendar v3 events.list request deadline

question: Should Google Meet Calendar v3 events.list adopt a hardcoded 30s default request deadline for existing Calendar lookups?
rationale: The patch fixes a real unbounded request path with an existing timeout seam, but it changes shipped slow-request behavior and the latest proof no longer exercises a real hanging transport.

options.title: Accept 30s Deadline With Proof Gate
options.body: Keep the code shape, require a real hanging-transport proof or maintainer proof override, then merge after exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Accept Current Proof And Risk
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept both the 30s fail-closed compatibility change and the mock-only timeout proof as sufficient for this small plugin fix.

options.title: Pause For Shared Timeout Policy
options.body: Hold this PR until Calendar, Meet v2, Drive export, and Google auth timeout defaults are reviewed as one Google plugin policy.

recommendation.title: Accept 30s Deadline With Proof Gate
